what_changed: REBUILD 2026-11-09 (gate round 2, Kilian 'Hedge-book build' card): Q4 FY2026 and FY2027-28 rebuilt bottom-up. Generation margin = hedge book (deck slide 20: realized price x TWh less gas at hub - spark) + non-book items calibrated on H1 2026 actuals vs the book (-1.96 $/MWh) + Texas PTC change; capacity from every slide-21 position incl. Cogentrix; retail $/MWh 2024-26 mean on a two-year weather-normal volume (replaces the -0.8%/yr trend fit); fixed costs from Vistra's own Lotus step per MW; quarter splits from 2023-25 shares. FY2028 hedged price = mean 2028 forward over four decks less the 2027 back-test gap, plus Meta at full delivery (+487). FY2029 not priced (Kilian), FY2028 copied, no value effect. Results: FY2026 7,366 (guide 7,100-7,500), FY2027 7,706 (was 8,254; guide 7,700-8,500, mid 8,100), FY2028 7,933 (was 8,159), NTM at horizon 7,877 (was 8,140). Engine value 139.25 vs 152.45 (-8.7%), incl. the growth term on the exit multiple (8.9x -> 8.71x, -3.5%, Kilian 2026-11-10) and the 11-10 gate fixes. Superseded first gate round of this update, kept for the record: Q3 FY2026 (release 2026-11-06; 10-Q not yet filed): Ongoing Ops Adj. EBITDA 2,378 vs our 2,017 (+17.9%) and Street ~2,100 (TIKR, pre-print); Generation (T/E/W + corp) 2,280 vs our 1,980, Retail 98 vs 37; generation 65.5 TWh vs our 62.0. Guides: 2026 narrowed to 7.1-7.5B (midpoint +100), 2027 initiated at 7.7-8.5B incl. Cogentrix and the Meta Perry PPA, hedged 98% for 2027 and 78% for 2028. Record: two closed periods (FY2024 +17.8% with an excluded PTC, FY2025 +1.9%); we use the clean +1.9%: FY2026 7,439 (Q4 1,800), FY2027 8,250, both inside the ranges. FY2028-29 step from the FY2027 book with the AWS ramp and Cogentrix capacity (2028 forwards above 2027 per the Oct-30 deck): 8,197 / 8,087 after the moratorium terms. Cogentrix closed 2026-10-30 (8-K 11-05): out of the planned bridge and into the company's Q3 pro forma net debt 21,793 (incl. AR financing and the junior notes), preferred 1,488 after the B Series A redemption, 339.0M shares, tax NPV at probability 1.0; buybacks .2B/yr at 12.89 (shares.buyback), horizon 330.3M, net debt 20,061 at 2027-11-05. Moratorium weights aligned to the shared basis (none 0.25 / Texas 0.45 / spread 0.30, Kilian card 11-05): ercot 0.25a + 0.75b, pjm B-9b - 0.30 x zone gap; retail offset FY2028/29 +98.7 / +110.8; post-horizon adjustment -494.6 -> -1,253.7. Engine value 145.81 -> 153.19 (+5.1%): date roll +0.05, weights -2.72, EBITDA path +5.04, balance +2.84, shares +1.97, Cogentrix tax +0.21.
